evidence.reason: The test is explicitly named and commented as proving the helper is never imported on a digest mismatch, but the assertions at the cited invocation only observe refusal, stderr/error JSON, lock absence, record-dir emptiness, and unchanged HEAD. None observes whether `prepare-host.py` was actually loaded, so a controller that imports it and then rejects the digest before lock/preflight would still pass. This is a concrete minor test-coverage defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
